intended_object: For a space X presented as homeomorphic to a cofiltered limit lim X_j of finite discrete spaces, the j-th coordinate map X → X_j, i.e. the limit projection π_j composed with the presentation homeomorphism (from the docstring).
explanation: The body is the underlying function of `stageMap j`, which sends x to `(P.equiv x).1 j`: the homeomorphism into the explicit limit (a subtype of the product), followed by the j-th coordinate. That is exactly the limit projection composed with the homeomorphism, as the docstring says. The file's lemmas `stage_apply`, `stage_naturality`, `ext` and `ofProfinite_stage_apply` (which recovers the quotient map `A.proj` for discrete quotients) all match the intended object. It is defined for any space with such a presentation, so it is not too narrow. Mathlib has the cone projection `(Profinite.limitCone F).π.app j` out of the limit itself, but nothing composed with a presentation homeomorphism.
